entities.name: Zahur
entities.description: Leonin zombie warrior charioteer from Amonkhet from the lost era before Nicol Bolas, co-captain of the Champions of Amonkhet.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker dragon who scoured Zahur's name from history.

entities.name: Basri Ket
entities.description: Found Zahur's tomb and became his close friend.

entities.name: Maahestet
entities.description: Once dominant leonin race of declining undead led by Zahur.

entities.name: Broken Lands
entities.description: Region where Basri found Zahur's tomb.

events.summary: Bolas trespasses on Amonkhet and scours Zahur's name from history.
Basri Ket discovers Zahur's tomb in the Broken Lands, and Zahur rises after the proper rites.
events.quote: Zahur rose from his grave and proudly stepped into the role of co-captain

events.summary: Zahur and Basri bond after fighting tomb demons together.
events.quote: He and Basri formed a close bond after fighting a couple of tomb demons together.

events.summary: Zahur is the first racer across the finish line, winning the Aetherspark.
events.quote: Zahur was the first racer to cross the finish line of the Grand Prix
